summary: Lattice observation tower in Allen Parish, Louisiana. Thin record: no build date, staffing or fate found in the sources.

evidence.supports: Central US Lookouts lists the tower under the Louisiana Forestry Commission
OpenStreetMap names the tower Elizabeth Lookout Tower
OpenStreetMap tags the tower construction as lattice
OpenStreetMap tags the tower type as observation
Funds from 1915 allowed hiring lookout watchmen or patrolmen
evidence.quote: In 1915 funds were directed for fire protection work allowing the hiring of lookout watchmen or patrolmen.

evidence.supports: 39 towers built by 1943 and 56 by 1950 (state total)
evidence.quote: By 1943 thirty-nine fire towers had been built and by 1950 the number had increased to fifty-six.

evidence.supports: Many state towers still exist, most inactive, many kept in reserve
evidence.quote: Many fire towers still exist with the majority being inactive but many are maintained in reserve.

evidence.supports: Directory lists an Elizabeth Fire Tower under fire departments
evidence.quote: Elizabeth Fire Tower is Fire Departments, Fire Lookout Stations, Public Health and Safety company

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. No source found gives a build year, staffing, fire history or fate. An anyplaceamerica.com topo page calls this tower the Turner Lookout Tower, but the site returned HTTP 403 and that name comes only from a search snippet, so it is not used. The USBIZS entry is an unverified business listing and may refer to a fire station rather than this tower; its 'Year Established: 1987' is a company field and is not used. OpenStreetMap ele 43 is a node elevation, not a height, so it is not used. The Wikipedia Louisiana list does not include this tower, and its own note calls the list incomplete. Check Allen Parish and Louisiana Forestry Commission (LDAF) records and the local fire department before publishing.
